title: Settings
profileNote: These apply to the profile "{name}", and to it on every device you are signed in on.
profileNoteUnnamed: These apply to the profile you have open.

enableDragAndDrop.title: Enable drag & drop
enableDragAndDrop.explanation: Drag a link to reorder it, into a subgroup or into another group; drag a group to move it along the row.

hideTips.title: Hide tips
hideTips.explanation: Stop showing the tips along the bottom of the page. This is where they come back from.

uiScale.title: Size
uiScale.explanation: How big everything is drawn. This one is kept on this device only - a desktop and a laptop want different answers, and one should not decide for the other.

closedTabsOpenDelay.title: Recently closed tabs: opening delay
closedTabsOpenDelay.explanation: How long the pointer has to rest on the recently closed tabs rail before it opens, so that passing over it on the way to the menu does not. Kept on this device only.

language.title: Language
language.explanation: What this extension speaks. "Follow the browser" uses your browser's own language, and falls back to English where this extension has no translation. Kept on this device only.

dateFormat.title: Date format
dateFormat.explanation: How dates are written. "Local custom" writes them the way your browser's region does. Kept on this device only.

searchEngine.title: Search engine
searchEngine.explanation: Where the search bar at the top of the page sends what you type. "Default search engine" is the one your browser is set to, and is used until you choose another - here or with the icon beside the bar. Kept on this device only.

backgroundImage.title: Background
backgroundImage.explanation: Put a picture of your own behind the page, in place of the logo in the corner. It covers the whole window and is kept on this device only.
backgroundImage.proOnly: Only Pro users can change the background.
backgroundImage.failed: That file could not be used as a background. Try another picture.

bookmarkShortcut.title: Shortcut to save a page
bookmarkShortcut.explanation: The keys that save the page you are on into Tabilinks. Chrome lets you change them only on its own shortcuts page - set Ctrl+D there and it saves here instead of into Chrome's bookmarks.
